topic: Decide which programming language for a new internal tool

scenario.topic: Decide which programming language for a new internal tool
scenario.opening_question: What trade-offs between development speed, maintainability, and team familiarity matter most for this internal tool?

options.name: Python with Django Framework
options.upside: Rapid prototyping with a mature web framework and strong community support
options.tradeoff: May have performance limitations for CPU-intensive tasks
options.concern: Some team members have limited recent experience with Django
options.best_for: fast development with maintainability and rich libraries

options.name: TypeScript with React Frontend
options.upside: Strong type safety and excellent UI capabilities with familiar tools
options.tradeoff: Requires more initial setup and frontend focus may limit backend flexibility
options.concern: Backend integration might be more complex and slower to develop
options.best_for: user-friendly interfaces with type-safe code and team expertise

options.name: Go with Gin Web Framework
options.upside: High performance and easy deployment with strong concurrency support
options.tradeoff: Longer ramp-up time due to unfamiliarity and fewer libraries
options.concern: Team may struggle with Go idioms and slower initial development

options.name: Java with Spring Boot Framework
options.upside: Robust enterprise-grade framework with strong tooling and scalability
options.tradeoff: Slower development cycle and heavier resource usage
options.concern: May be overkill for a small internal tool and increase complexity
options.best_for: scalable, maintainable systems where robustness is critical

shared_context: The tool must be ready within 3 months
The project budget is moderate but fixed
The decision group has exactly 3 participants with varied programming backgrounds

personas.name: Thea
personas.background: As a developer interested in UI/UX and type safety, Thea values strong frontend capabilities and team familiarity.
personas.private_goal: I want a language that balances good UI support with maintainability and team expertise.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara leads the frontend team and prioritizes rapid development with familiar tools to meet tight deadlines.
personas.private_goal: I want a solution that leverages our team's strong React and TypeScript skills for faster delivery.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative

personas.name: Wyatt
personas.background: Wyatt is focused on backend performance and maintainability but is cautious about team ramp-up time.
personas.private_goal: I want a backend language that ensures long-term maintainability and good performance without slowing development too much.
personas.rejection_reason: Backend integration complexity and slower development with TypeScript React conflicts with my need for maintainable and performant backend solutions.
